subject: Post-call: Linguae localization pilot proposal & eval pack
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lucie Martin <lucie.martin@linguae.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Linguae localization pilot proposal & eval pack

Hi Lucie — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick written recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Goal: improve user-facing NLU + generation for multi-country support (FR, DE, JA, ZH) within Linguae's customer-facing flows (FAQs, content transformation, chat assist).
- Constraints: strict EU residency for customer data, preference for low-latency <350ms for chat, budget-conscious pilot (proof-of-value).

Model fit recommendations (initial shortlist)
- Redwood-candela-1.5q (8k window) — recommended for FR/DE (solid hallucination control + cost-efficient fp16 path).
- open-llm-phi-70b-8k-q4 — candidate for JA/ZH where multilingual training signals help; use as a fallback for high-complexity prompts.
- Redwood-small-translate (quantized) — useful as a low-cost preprocessor for quick translation + intent classification.

Quality/regression concerns we flagged on call
- French: formality variants (vous/tu) and legal phrasing — need locale-specific prompt templates and eval cases.
- German: compound handling and neutral gender forms — recommend targeted test prompts.
- Japanese: politeness levels and keigo edge cases — requires curated eval set and human review for initial rollout.
- Chinese: numeric/date formatting differences across locales.

What I attached / links
- prompt-starter-linguae.zip — starter prompt sets (per-locale) and example API calls.
- linguae_eval_results_v1.csv — short bench on a small sample of your demo data (sanitized).
- drive link to full benchmark + eval dashboards in related_links.

Proposed pilot scope / next steps
1) Confirm language priority (please rank FR / DE / JA / ZH).
2) Sign pilot SOW (attached draft) — target: 6-week pilot, two-week per-locale sprint for evaluation + iteration.
3) Share 2–3 representative sample conversations per locale (PII removed) for prompt tuning and regression tests.
4) Kickoff meeting: propose Tue 28 Dec or Tue 4 Jan — 30–45 minutes.
5) We will provision a dedicated test pool in eu-west-1 and enable a regression monitor (prompt/metric-based) during the pilot.

Notes on residency & privacy
- For EU residency we recommend Redwood Private (VPC) or Dedicated in eu-west-1. We'll include the KMS/HSM diagram in the SOW appendix.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a revised SOW and a sample timeline after you confirm languages and legal contact.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment stubs: prompt-starter-linguae.zip (12 files), linguae_eval_results_v1.csv (1 file), pilot-sow-draft.pdf (1 file)

Looping in quick internal guidance based on Lucie's reply and our call notes. 

1) Pilot configuration (proposal)
- Provision Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 with capacity for 20 concurrent chat sessions (burst to 40) — keeps KV/cache and logs in region.
- Models: primary = Redwood-candela-1.5q (FR/DE), secondary fallback = phi-70b-q4 (JA/ZH). Preprocessor = Redwood-small-translate quantized.
- Cost: rough pilot estimate = $28k–$40k (infrastructure + eng support + SOW), final after exact capacity and SLA choices. I'll validate with finance but use as planning figure.

2) Evaluation plan / metrics
- Per-locale prompt sets (we already included starter pack).
- Metrics: edit-distance/fluency proxies, intent accuracy, and manual human-rating for politeness/formality where relevant.
- Regression watchlist: French vous/tu and legal wording, German concord, Japanese keigo. Create explicit failcases in the eval harness.

3) Ops & monitoring
- Enable token-level tracing but redact PII. Add regression alerting (daily) to Slack channel for Linguae pilot.
- Suggest A/B variant test in week 3: candela baseline vs candela+prompt-tune.

4) Next steps for Mina
- Update SOW to include KMS diagram, residency clause, and pilot cost range.
- Add Marc Delacroix to the SOW circulation.

Happy to take the lead on metric definitions and the regression watchlist.
Neha
Sr. Product Manager, Redwood Inference
